about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_yq.py). bad replays the structured-data query miss: it throws the real miss line, or silently queries the wrong file. good runs the fixed query and prints the report it promises.

fixture.breakage.py:
import yaml

yaml.safe_load(open("broken.yml", encoding="utf-8"))
print("parsed clean")
fixture.config.yml:
name: orders
version: 3
database:
  host: db.internal
  ports:
    - 5432
    - 5433
fixture.entry.py:
import sys

kind = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
table = {"yaml": ("config.yml", "yq"), "xml": ("feed.xml", "xq"), "toml": ("app.toml", "tomlq")}
name, prog = table[kind]
text = open(name, encoding="utf-8").read()
assert text.strip()
print(f"entry PASS {prog}-handles-{kind}")
fixture.flags.txt:
yq: jq wrapper for YAML documents (README.rst line 1). transcodes YAML to JSON, pipes to jq.
default entry: yq reads yaml via input_format=yaml; cli line 102 sets input_format plus program_name=yq.
xq sets input_format=xml for XML docs; tomlq sets input_format=toml for TOML docs.
--yaml-output/-y line 26: convert jq output back into YAML; default stays JSON.
-i/--in-place: only with -y/-Y/-t/-T/-x and filename args, never stdin.
--yaml-frontmatter/-F: one YAML header doc, JSON or YAML out; body passes through.
-Y/--yaml-roundtrip: annotated_yaml keeps tags styles comments; filters must expect metadata.
staged errors: reading YAML input names the file; jq produced invalid JSON names the stage.
fixture.front.py:
lines = open("post.md", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines(keepends=True)
assert lines[0].strip() == "---"
end = next(i for i in range(1, len(lines)) if lines[i].strip() in ("---", "..."))
header = "".join(lines[1:end])
body = "".join(lines[end + 1:])
assert "draft" in header and "Body" in body
print("front PASS one-header-doc")
fixture.inplace.py:
import yaml

doc = yaml.safe_load(open("config.yml", encoding="utf-8"))
doc["version"] = 4
open("config.yml", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(yaml.safe_dump(doc))
back = yaml.safe_load(open("config.yml", encoding="utf-8"))
assert back["version"] == 4
print("inplace PASS wrote-with-yaml-output")
fixture.post.md:
---
draft: true
title: Notes
---
Body text here.
fixture.transcode.py:
import json

import yaml

doc = yaml.safe_load(open("config.yml", encoding="utf-8"))
print(json.dumps(doc)[:60])
print("transcode PASS yaml-to-json")
fixture.yamlout.py:
import yaml

doc = yaml.safe_load(open("config.yml", encoding="utf-8"))
text = yaml.safe_dump(doc, default_flow_style=False)
open("out.yml", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text)
assert "database" in text
print("yamlout PASS back-into-yaml")

pairs.bad: throw 'Expecting value: fed config.yml straight to a JSON reader with no YAML-to-JSON transcode'
throw 'no conversion of jq output is done: pipeline printed JSON where the next step needs YAML'
throw 'queried feed.xml with the plain yq entry point, which reads YAML input'
throw 'queried feed.xml with the tomlq entry point, which reads TOML input'
throw 'frontmatter needs YAML input: sent feed.xml with --yaml-frontmatter'
throw 'yq: -i/--in-place can only be used with -y/-Y/-t/-T/-x: tried plain JSON output'
throw 'asked for an annotated round-trip but stayed on plain json out, which keeps nothing'
rg -n "input_format" config.yml; throw 'missed input_format: config.yml carries no entry-point setting'
rg -n "program_name" feed.xml; throw 'missed program_name: feed.xml carries no program setting'
rg -n "yaml-output" app.toml; throw 'missed yaml-output: app.toml carries no output flag'
rg -n "jq wrapper" app.toml; throw 'missed jq wrapper: app.toml carries no wrapper phrase'
